# UAE eVTOL

> Independent primary-source reference for eVTOL infrastructure in the United Arab Emirates: operators, aircraft, vertiports, routes, regulators across Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Every claim traces to a named primary source. No aggregation, no invented launch dates.

Languages: English (canonical), Arabic (/ar/), French (/fr/), German (/de/), Chinese (/zh/). Sister site: https://qatarevtol.com

Editorial bar: contracted, built, flight-tested, or regulated — backed by primary-source documentation. Entities failing that bar are documented transparently on the did-not-make-the-cut page.


## Operators

- [Abu Dhabi Aviation](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/abu-dhabi-aviation.html): Abu Dhabi Aviation (ADA) is the named eVTOL operating partner under Archer Aviation's UAE Launch Edition definitive agreement. Group CEO Mahmood Al Ha
- [Archer Aviation — Abu Dhabi](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/archer-aviation-abu-dhabi.html): Archer Aviation's Abu Dhabi launch programme: Midnight eVTOL, ADIO and Abu Dhabi Aviation partnership, vertiport network, GCAA certification status.
- [BETA Technologies, Inc.](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/beta-technologies.html): BETA Technologies supplies eVTOL charging hardware to Abu Dhabi Airports. Its first Charge Cube is commissioned at Al Bateen Executive Airport, Abu Dh
- [Eve Air Mobility](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/eve-air-mobility.html): Eve Air Mobility's UAE record: a 2022 Falcon Aviation letter of intent for up to 35 eVTOLs and a 2023 Kookiejar Urban ATM deal. No UAE operations to d
- [REGENT Craft, Inc.](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/regent-seaglider.html): REGENT Craft plans Abu Dhabi seaglider manufacturing with the Strategic Development Fund. Seagliders are maritime wing-in-ground craft, not eVTOL airc
- [Roads and Transport Authority — Dubai](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/rta-dubai.html): RTA Dubai oversees the Emirate's eVTOL air-taxi network. Holds 6-year exclusive agreement with Joby (Feb 2024) and Skyports vertiport contract.
- [Skyports Infrastructure](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/skyports-infrastructure.html): Skyports Infrastructure: London-based vertiport developer, exclusive builder of Dubai's Joby/RTA vertiport network. VDX technically complete April 202
- [TCab Tech (Shanghai Time Technology Co.)](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/tcab-tech.html): TCab Tech's UAE activity is an MoU with Abu Dhabi's Autocraft for up to 350 E20 eVTOLs. No UAE flights, no facility and no GCAA approval are on record
- [The Helicopter Company (THC)](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/the-helicopter-company.html): The Helicopter Company (THC) is a Saudi Public Investment Fund subsidiary. Signed MoUs with Archer Aviation and Joby Aviation in November 2025 for Sau
- [VPorts](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/vports.html): VPorts signed a 2022 agreement with the UAE GCAA and Dubai South for a 37,000 sqm advanced air mobility integrator centre. No primary evidence it was 
- [Vertical Aerospace](https://evtolemirates.com/operators/vertical-aerospace.html): UK-based Vertical Aerospace has no documented UAE presence - no order, vertiport or GCAA agreement. Its only Gulf activity is a set of Saudi MoUs from

## Aircraft

- [Archer Midnight (Abu Dhabi)](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/archer-midnight-abu-dhabi.html): Archer Aviation Midnight in Abu Dhabi: first UAE flight 2 July 2025 at Al Bateen, full eVTOL envelope completed November 2025 with Abu Dhabi Aviation.
- [Archer Midnight — UAE Launch Edition Flight Test Campaign](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/archer-midnight-uae-launch-edition.html): Archer Aviation's Midnight eVTOL completed in-country UAE flight test campaign culminating 14 November 2025. Full-envelope desert testing as part of t
- [EHang EH216-S (UAE)](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/ehang-eh216-s-uae.html): EHang EH216-S in the UAE: completed the Middle East's first passenger-carrying pilotless eVTOL demo flight in Abu Dhabi on 6 May 2024. Specs and miles
- [EHang EH216-S Mecca Hajj Flight](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/ehang-eh216-s-mecca.html): The EHang EH216-S pilotless eVTOL completed its debut flight in Saudi Arabia on 12 June 2024 during the Hajj season in Mecca. First autonomous eVTOL p
- [Joby S4 (UAE Operations)](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/joby-s4-uae.html): Joby S4 in UAE service: all-electric eVTOL flown in Dubai since June 2025, first UAE point-to-point flight on 9 November 2025. Specs, milestones, sour
- [Joby S4 Hybrid-Electric Demonstrator](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/joby-s4-hybrid-electric.html): Joby S4-T hybrid-electric demonstrator: first flight 7 November 2025, Marina California. Defense-focused; no UAE deployment announced. Sources verifie
- [Lilium Jet — Saudia Group Sales Agreement](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/lilium-jet-saudia.html): Saudia and Lilium signed a binding sales agreement on 18 July 2024 for up to 100 Lilium Jets. Lilium filed final insolvency 21 February 2025; prototyp
- [Volocopter NEOM Flight & $175M Investment](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/volocopter-neom-historical.html): NEOM invested $175M in Volocopter (Nov 2022) with 15-aircraft order and GACA-authorized flight 21 June 2023. Volocopter filed insolvency 26 Dec 2024; 
- [Volocopter VoloCity (UAE History)](https://evtolemirates.com/aircraft/volocopter-volocity-uae.html): Volocopter VoloCity UAE history: world-first autonomous air taxi flight in Dubai 25 September 2017. Programme ended after Volocopter insolvency Decemb

## Vertiports

- [Al Bateen Executive Airport (AZI) Vertiport](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/al-bateen-vertiport.html): Al Bateen Executive Airport (AZI) Vertiport is under construction as the second foundational node of Abu Dhabi's 10-vertiport network. Site of Archer 
- [Al Maktoum International Airport Vertiport (DWC)](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/al-maktoum-international-vertiport.html): Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) was the landing site of the UAE's first piloted eVTOL flight on 9 November 2025. A formal vertiport is not conf
- [American University of Dubai Vertiport](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/american-university-of-dubai-vertiport.html): American University of Dubai Vertiport, announced 17 November 2025 by Joby and the RTA. Wasl Asset Management Group is the property partner. Launching
- [Atlantis The Royal Vertiport](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/atlantis-the-royal-vertiport.html): Atlantis The Royal Vertiport, Palm Jumeirah node of Dubai's eVTOL network announced 17 November 2025. Joby Aviation, RTA, Skyports - status and source
- [DXB Vertiport](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/dxb-vertiport.html): DXB Vertiport reached technical completion on 16 April 2026. Built by Skyports Infrastructure adjacent to Dubai International Airport. Joby Aviation o
- [Dubai Mall Vertiport](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/dubai-mall-vertiport.html): Dubai Mall Vertiport, announced 17 November 2025 by Joby and the RTA, with Emaar Properties as the property partner. Construction set to begin in 2026
- [Dubai Marina Vertiport](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/dubai-marina-vertiport.html): Dubai Marina Vertiport is the second node of Dubai's eVTOL network. Confirmed under construction by Skyports Infrastructure as of 16 April 2026, under
- [Margham Flight Test Facility](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/margham-flight-test-facility.html): Joby Aviation's UAE eVTOL flight test site at Margham, Dubai. Site of the first piloted point-to-point eVTOL flight in the UAE on 9 November 2025.
- [Palm Jumeirah Vertiport at Atlantis the Royal](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/palm-jumeirah-vertiport.html): Palm Jumeirah Vertiport at Atlantis the Royal, named by Joby and the RTA on 17 November 2025. Construction set to begin in months following Skyports' 
- [Zayed International (AUH) Vertiport](https://evtolemirates.com/vertiports/zayed-international-vertiport.html): AUH Vertiport at Zayed International Airport is under construction as the first node of Abu Dhabi's 10-vertiport advanced air mobility network. Partne

## Routes

- [Abu Dhabi Network — Route 1 (Abu Dhabi ↔ Dubai)](https://evtolemirates.com/routes/abu-dhabi-network-route-1.html): Archer Aviation and Falcon Aviation plan Abu Dhabi to Dubai eVTOL route: Marina Mall heliport (Corniche) to Falcon Heliport at Atlantis the Palm, ~30 
- [Abu Dhabi Network — Route 2](https://evtolemirates.com/routes/abu-dhabi-network-route-2.html): Abu Dhabi Network Route 2 is the second corridor in the emirate 10+ vertiport plan. Endpoints not yet published; AUH and AZI confirmed as first anchor
- [DXB ↔ Atlantis The Royal](https://evtolemirates.com/routes/dxb-to-atlantis-the-royal.html): Joby Aviation route between DXB and Atlantis The Royal vertiport, Palm Jumeirah: ~10-minute flight planned for 2026 launch under RTA exclusive agreeme
- [DXB ↔ Dubai Mall](https://evtolemirates.com/routes/dxb-to-dubai-mall.html): Joby Aviation route between DXB and Dubai Mall vertiports, planned for 2026 commercial launch under exclusive RTA agreement. Primary sources verified.
- [Margham → Al Maktoum International (DWC)](https://evtolemirates.com/routes/margham-to-al-maktoum.html): Joby flew the UAE's first piloted point-to-point eVTOL route on 9 November 2025: 17 minutes from Margham flight test facility to DWC. Sources verified
- [Margham → Al Maktoum International (DWC)](https://evtolemirates.com/routes/margham-to-dwc.html): The Joby S4 completed the first electric-air-taxi point-to-point flight in the UAE on 9 November 2025, flying piloted from Margham to Al Maktoum Inter

## Regulators

- [Abu Dhabi Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT)](https://evtolemirates.com/regulators/abu-dhabi-dmt.html): Abu Dhabi DMT, established by Law No. 30 of 2019, oversees urban planning and transport in the emirate via affiliates including Abu Dhabi Mobility (IT
- [Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO)](https://evtolemirates.com/regulators/adio-abu-dhabi.html): The Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) is the strategic government counterparty for Archer Aviation's UAE Launch Edition. Director General Badr Al-Ola
- [Dubai Future Foundation](https://evtolemirates.com/regulators/dubai-future-foundation.html): Dubai Future Foundation: Dubai Government's foresight authority. Convening role on eVTOL via Dubai Self-Driving Strategy, drone programme, accelerator
- [General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), Saudi Arabia](https://evtolemirates.com/regulators/gaca-saudi-arabia.html): GACA published the Advanced Air Mobility Roadmap in January 2024. Issued Special Flight Authorization for Volocopter NEOM flight 21 June 2023. Signed 
- [General Civil Aviation Authority — UAE](https://evtolemirates.com/regulators/gcaa-uae.html): GCAA UAE is the federal civil aviation regulator overseeing eVTOL type certification, vertiport regulations and Air Operator Certificates in the UAE.
